svg.title: Research Architect and High Command, software from PhalAInx
svg.desc: The current Research Architect icon, silver-and-cyan wordmark, and published technical white paper represent the framework for human research teams. A current High Command Command Deck capture represents the desktop application for individuals. Research Architect is a development preview; High Command is in alpha testing.
svg.text: RA 2.6.1 preview / Approve the written plans before creating assistant kits
